description: This PHP class defines financial functions related to securities pricing, such as calculating security prices, discounted prices, prices at maturity, and amounts received, including validation routines for input parameters.

classes.name: Price
classes.description: Provides static methods for calculating security prices, discounted security prices, prices at maturity, and amounts received, with input validation.

methods.name: price
methods.description: Calculates the price per $100 face value of a security that pays periodic interest, based on settlement, maturity, rate, yield, redemption, frequency, and basis.

methods.name: priceDiscounted
methods.description: Calculates the price of a discounted security per $100 face value, based on settlement, maturity, discount rate, redemption value, and basis.

methods.name: priceAtMaturity
methods.description: Calculates the security price at maturity, considering settlement, maturity, issue date, rate, yield, and basis.

methods.name: received
methods.description: Returns the amount received at maturity for a fully invested security, given settlement, maturity, investment amount, discount rate, and basis.
